rationale:
Evidence. The best raced design is iteration 5 (score 160.4): kp 2.5, sensor_size 0.016, base_speed 1.3, kd 0.3, ki 0.05, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], line_loss search_right. Every run in every iteration since iteration 2 has ended off_track, with max_error stuck at about 0.060 to 0.063 m against the 0.06 m limit. Iteration 6 raised kd to 0.45 with search_right, and the score fell to 143.1. The oval steering_oscillation rose to 0.333, above the 0.3 threshold, max_error rose on the oval (0.0604 to 0.0624) and slalom (0.0616 to 0.0679), and the oval finish rate fell to 0. Entity R1's feedback is written for the kd 0.45 test, but that race has already happened. Its own rule applies: if oscillation exceeds 0.3 or max_error rises, revert kd to 0.3 and test a different lever. The line-loss side is still untested, and search_right changed almost nothing in iteration 5, so the next test is line_loss search_left.

Change. I revert controller.kd from 0.45 to 0.3 and set controller.line_loss from search_right to search_left. This is a single-field change from the best raced design (iteration 5). Everything else stays fixed: sensor_size 0.016, base_speed 1.3, kp 2.5, ki 0.05, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2].

Expected result. If line losses are one-sided on the right of the tape, search_left should lower line_loss_events on the s-bend (2.0) and slalom (1.0). I expect max_error to stay near 0.060 to 0.062 m, because the iteration 5 evidence suggests line loss is not the main limit. A score change of more than about 5 points is unlikely.

Hypotheses and measurements. H1: line-loss direction matters on the s-bend, so search_left lowers its line_loss_events below 2.0. H2: if line_loss_events and max_error are both unchanged, the binding limit is steering geometry or base speed, and the next lever is base_speed 1.5, but only if max_error falls below about 0.058 m and completion_time is limiting. Needed per track: max_error, line_loss_events, steering_oscillation, progress, completion_time, completion.
